svg.title: Ktemata r5 airbrush scheme - STRATA
svg.desc: Continuity: the stack is keyed to x, not to y, so each rail runs dead straight from the cover into the deck and the U closes across the hinge. 32 mm of bands fills the deck's 40.95 mm rail and extends inboard of the cover's 7 mm painted-border datum. That border is not a raised ring, so the flat cover bands are clipped only by real apertures. This is the selected scheme; its SVG and printable STL stencils use the same rectangular marks as this sheet.
